notes.note: Hard to test: 'not a scope unit' has no directly observable effect; the test only uses integer, charstring and anytype values (anytype field 'integer') inside a test case. Titan warning is a Titan deviation: Titan requires an 'extension "anytype ..."' attribute, while per clause 6.2.6 anytype implicitly contains all known types.
Titan accepts it, but this exact case (local variable named like the module) is marked 'Is NOT allowed' in clause 5.2.2 example 3; Titan does not implement this check.

Titan accepts a module-level constant named like an enumerated value of a type in the same module; per 5.2.2 such identifiers shall only be reused for enumerated values or field names. Titan does not implement this check.

Ambiguity: narrower reading chosen (a constant of the imported enumerated type E named like one of E's values), which is the 'not allowed' case of clause 8.2.3.1 example 5. Titan does not implement this check.
Ambiguity: arbitrary order tested only at module level (forward use of types, constants, templates and functions), where both readings agree.
Clause 8.2 syntax (TemplateModifier) also allows template module parameters, so the test violates the rule with a timer module parameter, which is not value parameterization under either reading.
Hard to test: test only checks that the module parameter keeps its value read in control across two test case executions; it cannot observe that the value is resolved at the start of runtime.
Ambiguity: reading chosen that component types are excluded, as stated explicitly in clause 8.2 restriction b. Titan accepts it but does not implement that restriction.

Every kind of parameter is allowed for functions, so there is nothing to violate; test is a positive test using all allowed kinds (basic, user-defined, address, component, port, default, template, timer).
Same as 5.4.0-009c: positive test using all allowed formal parameter kinds of an altstep.

Ambiguity: reading chosen that omitted kinds are not allowed; supported by clause 5.4.1.0 restriction l (only functions and altsteps may have timer, port or default parameters). Test uses a timer parameter.
